title: Final check: the repository and requirements BR-01 to BR-20

repository.check: no .env file is tracked, now or in the history
.gitignore covers .env, data/, storage/, the raw audio in reports/ and the virtual environment
no API key or secret in any tracked file
the real value of SECRET_KEY in .env appears nowhere in the files or history
no API key pattern appears anywhere in the history
no real personal data: every e-mail address in the files is a fictional one (example.com and similar)
no large files or model weights are tracked
repository.detail: largest tracked file is under 15 MB; no model weights

repository.check: fictional data only is stated in the project rules
the working tree is committed (nothing left uncommitted)

requirements.requirement: Voice note to job description and weighted rubric; biased wording flagged
Read CVs in PDF, Word, scan and screenshot form; unclear fields go to review
Hide name, age, gender, photo, nationality and contact details before scoring
Set stages; stop for a person's approval before each move
Score each skill with the exact CV sentence behind each score
A ranked shortlist with strengths and gaps, approved by the recruiter
A first-round voice interview: spoken questions, diagrams, recorded and transcribed answers, follow-ups, each answer scored with a quote
Tell candidates AI is used before the interview; let them ask for a person
Answer recruiters' questions about the pool and the policy, with sources
Follow a recruiter-led interview: live transcript, suggested questions, key points, CV conflicts
Warn at once on a question that must not be asked
Draft emails; send nothing without a person's approval
Check every score has real evidence and no protected detail was used, before the recruiter sees it
Ignore instructions hidden in CVs, emails or spoken answers
One scorecard per candidate with every score, quote and link to the moment in the recording; the recruiter's decision and reason
Changing only name, gender or age clues, or the accent of the same answer, does not change the score
Cost per 100 CVs and per interview, and how fast the voice interview responds
A governance pack for the EU AI Act: classification, model card, risk register and evidence
Explain to a candidate, on request, why they were not shortlisted, reviewed by a recruiter before sending
Check certifications against a register and flag overlapping job dates
